selo.explica: Verified by the Alumia coordination: the account belongs to who it says. It does not mean Alumia supports this person.

pedir.sobre: For those who may be impersonated: public figures and educators. It is always free; there is no paid badge. The coordination checks through an official channel and keeps no document or proof, only the decision.

canais.perfil_oficial: Official profile already verified on another network

pedir.enviado: Request sent. The coordination will reach you through the chosen channel.
pedir.esperando: Your request has been waiting for the coordination since {data} ({canal}).
pedir.tem: Your profile has had the “{tipo}” badge since {data}. Only the coordination removes it.
pedir.org: Organization accounts use the organization badge, on the organization profile.

erros.ja_pedido: You already have a request waiting.
erros.ja_verificada: Your profile already has the badge.
erros.usar_selo_org: Organization accounts use the organization badge.
erros.desligado: The badge and counts are not turned on yet.

contagens.sobre: By default, nobody sees how many people follow you or how many supports your posts have. You can choose to show them. Below 3 only “fewer than 3” appears, and the list of who follows or supported never appears.
contagens.seguidores: Show how many people follow me
contagens.apoios: Show the number of supports on my posts
